title: Phylogenetic Analyses of the JEV Gene Sequence
author: Wenjing Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdbci2iw

steps.title: Extract Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Perform nucleic acid extraction in a biosafety cabinet using a Tianlong nucleic acid extraction instrument (model: np968. C, Suzhou Tianlong Biotechnology Co., Ltd.) and a Tianlong nucleic acid extraction kit (magnetic bead method EX-RNA/DNAvirus, Suzhou Tianlong Biotechnology Co., Ltd.).

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μl of patient cerebrospinal fluid, serum specimens, or mosquito grinding supernatant to each well in columns 1 and 7 of the provided 96-well plate.

steps.title: Prepare RNA for Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Heat 33 μl of RNA extract in a 65 °C water bath for 10 min.

steps.title: Perform First-Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA using a Ready-To-Go kit (GE Healthcare, Little Chalfont, Buckinghamshire, UK).

substeps.instruction: Pipette 32 μl of RNA samples into the first chain reaction tube and allow to stand at room temperature for 1 min.
Add 1 μl of random primer (pdN6) (TaKaRa, Japan) to every sample.

steps.title: Amplify E Gene via Semi-Nested PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the E gene sequence using a semi-nested PCR approach with a 25 μl reaction system consisting of 2 μl cDNA template, 12.5 μl GoTaq ® Green Master Mix-2 × (Promega, Madison, WI), 1 μl of upstream and downstream primers (10 μmol/L), and 8.5 μl RNase Free Water.

substeps.instruction: First round: Use primers JEV 3F (TTCATAGAAGGAGCCAGTGGA) and JEV 3R (TCGTTTAAACTCGCGACTGA).
Run PCR program: 94 °C for 8 min (1 cycle); 94 °C for 1 min, 55 °C for 1 min, 72 °C for 1 min (35 cycles); 72 °C for 10 min; hold at 4 °C.

Second round: Use the first round PCR product as template with forward primer JEV 3F and reverse primer JEV 2R (TTTCCCGAAAAGTCCACATC). Use the same reaction system and PCR program as the first round to produce a 300 bp sequence.

steps.title: Amplify C+PrM Gene via Semi-Nested PCR
steps.instruction: Amplify the C+PrM gene sequence using the same amplification system and PCR procedure as the E gene.

substeps.instruction: First round: Use primers JE-C+PrM-1F (CGTTCTTCAAGTTTACAGCATTAGC) and JE-C+PrM-1R (CCYRTGTTYCTGCCAAGCATCCAMCC).
Second round: Use the first round PCR product as template with primers JE-C+PrM-1F and JE-C+PrM-2R (CGYTTGGAATGYCTRGTCCG).

steps.title: Verify Amplification Products
steps.instruction: Detect 5 μL of the amplification product using 1% agarose gel electrophoresis.

steps.title: Determine and Process Nucleotide Sequences
steps.instruction: Obtain and refine the viral gene nucleotide sequences.

substeps.instruction: Perform nucleotide sequence determination via Sangon Biotech Co. Ltd. (Shanghai, China, Beijing Sequencing Department).
Spliced and correct sequences using SeqMan II software (DNA Star, Madison, WI, USA).

steps.title: Perform Phylogenetic Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the JEV gene sequences alongside sequences downloaded from GenBank (Table S1).

substeps.instruction: Perform ClustalW multiple sequence alignment using BioEdit (Version 7.0, Hall 1999).
Draw Neighbor-joining phylogenetic trees using MEGA6.0 with 1000 bootstrap replicates.
